description: Create a new Dagon account key (POST /v1/keys). No API key needed. The secret is shown only once: store it securely and configure your MCP connection to send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; never paste it into shared chats or files under version control.

name.description: Label for the key, up to 80 characters.
